_note: Templates. {UPPERCASE} slots draw a fresh atom each time; {lowercase} slots are the story's own fields ({first}, {place}, {want}...). {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} reuse something an earlier beat introduced: favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't. Tagged entries are favored in those genres.
entries: {SOMEONE} arrived in {place} {MANNER} with {THING}, and {first} could not look away.
{CLOSE} vanished {MANNER}, and only {THING} was left behind.
{SOMEONE} accused {first} of {CRIME}, and the {rival} believed it.

entries.text: A posse came through {place} hunting {SOMEONE}, and {first} knew where to find {THING}.
{SOMEONE} came out of the wood with {THING}, asking for {first} by name.
